import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        token = ""
    else:
        token = data[0]
    ans = 0
    start = 0
    n = len(token)
    while start < n:
        end = start + 1
        while end < n and token[end] == token[start]:
            end += 1
        if (end - start) % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        start = end
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
